hints.maxConcurrency: Max in-flight proxied requests to this provider (0 = unlimited). When full, requests go to other providers first, or queue briefly if all are full. Applies to this app's proxy only
hints.costMultiplier: 1 uses the model's base price; the current multiplier applies to all cost reports for this provider
hints.dailyCostLimit: Stops new requests for the day at 100%, or after ordinary blacklisting at 95%
hints.fallbackApiUrls: When the primary URL fails with a switchable error (network/408/421/429/5xx), fallbacks are tried in order within the same request; the provider only counts as failed after all URLs fail
hints.level: Lower numbers = higher priority. Level 1 providers are tried first, then Level 2, etc.
hints.apiEndpoint: Override the Codex default endpoint. Leave blank to use /responses.
hints.insecureSkipVerify: When enabled, this provider's TLS certificate is no longer verified (self-signed certs / corporate proxies). Man-in-the-middle risk — enable only for trusted internal endpoints
hints.requestSanitize: When enabled, non-standard fields and unsupported headers are removed before forwarding, fixing compatibility issues with LiteLLM and similar proxies
hints.availabilityMonitor: Enable background health checks for this provider. Checks are performed periodically to monitor availability.
hints.connectivityAutoBlacklist: Automatically blacklist this provider if health checks fail repeatedly
hints.availabilityAutoUnblock: Automatically remove an ordinary blacklist after two consecutive successful checks; daily-limit blocking is unaffected
hints.availabilityAdvancedConfig: Advanced configuration (test model, endpoint, timeout, check interval) can be edited on the Availability page
hints.availabilityTestModel: Model to use for health checks. Leave empty to use platform default.
hints.availabilityTestEndpoint: API endpoint for health checks. Leave empty to use platform default.
hints.availabilityTimeout: Timeout for health check requests in milliseconds (default: 15000)
hints.connectivityCheck: When enabled, connectivity to this provider will be tested periodically; enabling this may consume a small amount of tokens
hints.connectivityTestModel: Select a model for connectivity testing, or leave empty to use platform default
hints.connectivityTestEndpoint: Select or enter API endpoint path
hints.connectivityAuthType: Bearer is the default. Use X-API-Key when required by your Codex-compatible endpoint, or enter a custom header name.

connectivity.revealToTest: Reveal the configured API key before testing connectivity
